source_title: Frigidaire FFHB2740PS Owner Support (Water Filter ULTRAWF)
filter_location_text: Frigidaire FFHB2740PS French-door models use a PureSource Ultra cartridge in the top-right fresh-food compartment.
replacement_steps_summary: Frigidaire guidance for ULTRAWF: push to release the old filter, slide the new PureSource Ultra cartridge in until it locks, flush water, then reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Frigidaire recommends genuine PureSource Ultra filters; ULTRAWF is not interchangeable with EPTWFU01 or WF3CB housings.
notes: Tier 1 Frigidaire bundle for FFHB2740PS — Owner Support lists replacement filter ULTRAWF (PureSource Ultra).
